question: How do I move my Pi Network coins through Stellar, and can this server verify my Pi wallet?

golden.answer: Pi Network runs its own separate ledger, so Stellar cannot move Pi coins and I cannot verify a Pi wallet. I won't claim a bridge, compatibility, or transfer route. I can help with documented Stellar concepts.
keyFacts: Pi Network is a separate ledger from Stellar, so no Stellar route moves Pi coins.
Invents no bridge, compatibility, or Pi wallet verification.
avoid: Do NOT invent a Pi-to-Stellar bridge or transfer procedure.
golden.notes: Pi's software descends from stellar-core/SCP; stating that lineage is accurate and is not a compatibility claim.

sources.note: Pi's own MiCA whitepaper: consensus layer built on a fork of SCP; Pi runs its own layer-one blockchain.

sources.ref: https://api.mainnet.minepi.com/ (network_passphrase 'Pi Network') vs https://horizon.stellar.org/ (network_passphrase 'Public Global Stellar Network ; September 2015')
sources.note: Live Horizon root reads: distinct passphrases, so the ledgers are separate.
